figurative_meaning_en: Clamor from a crowd shouting together; uproar or commotion
example_sentences_in_bangla: বাজারে চিল্লাচিল্লি করে সবাই কেনাকাটা করছে।
সভায় চিল্লাচিল্লি শুনে কিছু বোঝা যাচ্ছে না।
example_sentences_in_english: The market is full of clamor as everyone shouts while shopping.
The meeting turned into an uproar with everyone yelling at once.
note: This is an onomatopoeic expression mimicking the sound of shouting, commonly used in Bengali to denote noisy gatherings.
